hostPorts.purpose: Emits bounded, redacted Milestone #17 Checkout observability events through the platform observability runtime.
Verifies buyer-entered shipping addresses through the configured postage provider before checkout commits address snapshots.
Supplies public processor configuration for Checkout-owned inline payment confirmation views.
Resolve the runtime-configurable rate-limit policy for anonymous cart/sell-list capture without Checkout querying Platform Operations storage.

actions: Start guest Buy Now checkout session

transientRecovery.behavior: Checkout session loader converts fresh-write 404, projection_freshness_timeout, and bounded gateway/service timeouts into temporary checkout recovery UI that actively revalidates on a bounded schedule until the session is pay-ready or the fresh-write token expires, then degrades to manual recovery.

Checkout confirmation reads the freshly confirmed checkout session before exposing the payment continuation. Payment detail freshness remains owned by Payments when the buyer follows the preserved fresh-write payment link.
Checkout session self-refresh uses exact checkout-session-page freshness and Checkout temporary recovery UI with bounded active revalidation until pay-ready or fresh-write token expiry.

Checkout originates the cross-context offer handoff and preserves the Checkout receipt; Marketplace submitted-offer detail owns exact offer-page freshness and bounded fresh-write not-found retry before the buyer sees the submitted offer.

exception.reason: Checkout only originates the offer handoff and does not own the destination read model. The post-write read is classified and enforced by marketplace.submitted-offer-detail, whose route forwards afterWrite to Marketplace offer-page freshness.

postWriteHandoffs.actorOwnership: The Checkout add-line command receipt is scoped to the signed-in or anonymous cart actor that opens the cart destination.

transientRecovery.behavior: Buy Cart self-refresh uses the fresh-read strategy for signed-in and anonymous cart reads: it waits on the exact checkout cart line page projection, evaluates any semantic add-line post-write handoff against the loaded cart and checkout seller-options read, converts valid afterWrite projection timeouts plus valid add-line empty-cart or selected-listing seller-option catch-up into temporary cart recovery, and converts expired add-line handoffs that still read empty into action-required empty-cart recovery while missing, malformed, or remove-to-empty receipts stay on the normal permanent/empty-cart path.

transientRecovery.behavior: Guest Buy Cart add-line handoffs load the shared account-cart route through the guest cart API; the loader forwards the fresh-write receipt to /guest/cart, waits on checkout_cart_line_pages before evaluating the semantic add-line handoff against the loaded cart and checkout seller-options read, keeps valid empty-cart or selected-listing seller-option catch-up states temporary, and converts expired empty-cart handoffs into action-required empty-cart recovery while malformed receipts fall back to the normal empty-cart path.

postWriteHandoffs.actorOwnership: The Checkout sell-list add-line command receipt is scoped to the signed-in or anonymous selling actor that opens the Sell List destination.

transientRecovery.behavior: Account Sell List self-refresh uses the fresh-read strategy for signed-in and anonymous Sell List reads: it waits on exact sell-list line and confirmation page projections, evaluates any semantic add-line post-write handoff against the loaded Sell List, and converts valid afterWrite projection timeouts or valid add-line empty-list handoffs into temporary Sell List recovery while missing, malformed, expired, or remove-to-empty receipts stay on the normal permanent/empty-list path.

actions: Start guest seller checkout from Sell List readiness

transientRecovery.behavior: Guest sell checkout revalidates checkout.sell-list-readiness.v1 from the anonymous Sell List and fails closed to Sell List readiness recovery; no label, payout, sale, settlement, notification, or account-history side effects are attempted in this slice.

exception.reason: Guest sell checkout is a readiness handoff, not a projection-backed destination read: the route revalidates checkout.sell-list-readiness.v1 from the anonymous Sell List before registration and fails closed to Sell List recovery without attempting sale, payout, shipment, settlement, notification, or account-history side effects.

transientRecovery.behavior: Sell checkout confirmation detail retries valid fresh-write confirmation 404s while checkout_sell_list_confirmation_pages catches up; duplicate no-op confirmations redirect without minting a new token, and permanent missing confirmations return to Sell List recovery.

visibleDestination.description: Buy Cart quantity, remove, and preferred-listing lock controls update visible rows, line totals, subtotal, cart count, seller context, and readiness immediately, then reconcile to the authoritative cart loader state.

proof.correction: The cart page uses one cart-level optimistic mutation controller that submits absolute quantity targets, remove, and preferred-listing lock writes with optimisticStrategy=optimistic-with-correction and correctionSource=fresh-read:loader-revalidation; quantity writes are serialized and coalesced per line group, stale loader data cannot replace newer optimistic cart state, fresh loader truth clears the optimistic override, and route-owned errors roll back to loader truth.

visibleDestination.description: Buy Cart API commands return Checkout-owned command snapshots: line id/version/status for single-line commands, bulk and merge counts for batch commands, and checkout.cart-readiness.v1 for readiness.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The cart route responds from the command result before projection reads: add, quantity, fulfillment, and remove return id/version/status; bulk and merge return command-owned counts; readiness returns the checkout.cart-readiness.v1 snapshot consumed by session start.

transientRecovery.behavior: Buy Cart add-to-cart forms submit through the account cart action, which redirects with a Checkout commit receipt; the account cart loader waits on checkout_cart_line_pages plus checkout seller-options data and shows temporary cart recovery for valid fresh-write projection lag.

visibleDestination.description: Sell List API commands return Checkout-owned command snapshots: line id/version/status for line commands, merge counts for account adoption, checkout.sell-list-readiness.v1 for readiness, and the persisted confirmation snapshot for seller checkout confirmation.

proof.authoritativeResponse: The Sell List API responds from command results without waiting for list projections; confirmation returns the command-owned confirmation snapshot and idempotent duplicate posts return the existing confirmation snapshot without replaying marketplace handoff.

transientRecovery.behavior: Sell List add/remove, evidence remediation, and readiness forms submit through the account Sell List action, which redirects to a fresh account Sell List read; the loader waits on line, confirmation, and Marketplace evidence responses, while seller checkout start revalidates checkout.sell-list-readiness.v1 before continuing.

Checkout session start, edit, reviewed fulfillment-preview recording, and confirmation commands return commit receipts that route actions preserve in afterWrite; session and confirmation loaders wait on checkout_session_pages and show bounded Checkout recovery for valid projection lag or service timeout.

Signed-in and guest checkout-start forms redirect to the buy checkout session with a Checkout commit receipt; the session loader waits on checkout_session_pages and renders bounded preparing-checkout recovery for fresh projection lag.

Checkout review updates and confirmation submit through the session action with commit receipts; redirects back to session or confirmation preserve afterWrite, and loaders wait on checkout_session_pages before rendering payable state or handoff copy.

Signed-in seller checkout confirmation redirects to the confirmation route with a Checkout commit receipt; the confirmation loader retries valid fresh-write 404s against checkout_sell_list_confirmation_pages and redirects only permanent missing confirmations back to Sell List recovery.

cart.purpose: Own long-lived buy cart intent before an active checkout session starts.

sell-list.purpose: Own seller checkout intent before selected offers or product-level Smart Match lines become sale commitments.

sessions.purpose: Own checkout session lifecycle, review state, selected shipping, and orchestration status.

support-lookup.purpose: Own support-safe lookup of Checkout-owned pending and committed checkout facts.

request-support.purpose: Provide checkout request API clients and Checkout-owned Ordering/Payments confirmation adapters for routes and external purchase-intent entry points.

route-support.purpose: Provide checkout route loader/action modules for buy checkout and sell checkout route adapters.

runtime-support.purpose: Provide checkout runtime service and schema composition until runtime composition can be generated.

seed-support.purpose: Publish deterministic checkout session seed ids for checkout-owned cart and started-session development data.

ucp-support.purpose: Provide Checkout-owned UCP adapters for AI-agent checkout operations without moving buyer authorization or session lifecycle rules into deployables.

routes.purpose: Expose checkout-owned route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.
